description: A man in a flat cap and white apron stirs caramel-coated popcorn and nuts in a large wooden barrel with a scoop, and holds up a paper cone of the coated snack. Behind him, a well-dressed crowd in top hats, bowler hats and a feathered hat watches at dusk, with a white arched classical exhibition building lit up in the background. A lantern hangs in the stall and jars sit on the shelves. Oil-painting style, filling the frame edge to edge, with no text.
